verdict.rationale: WorkOS ships first-party AuthKit framework SDKs: Next.js helpers for authentication and session management, and an Astro SDK documenting session validation, token refresh, and route protection. TanStack Start, React, and Laravel integrations add peer-framework coverage, and the Rust SDK exposes session and JWKS helpers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of middleware-based session verification at the edge (e.g., Next.js middleware/edge runtime), explicit route-protection docs for the Next.js SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration.
